validity.recommendation: Real, correctly classified, single-owner project. Not a duplicate of P4449/P4451 -- P4449 (parent) is DMLC's conversion of the pre-existing Wet Header gathering system to dry gas transmission service, P4451 is the sibling Norwalk Manistee Connector, and P4450/this row is the Rogers City Connector -- three distinct scopes under one MPSC certificate (Case No. U-20894). Caveat: independent sources confirm the combined ~6 route-miles of new pipe for the two connectors together (matching GEM's 2+4=6 mi split) and the $7M MPSC-approved cost estimate specifically attributed to this connector, but no accessible document breaks out RCC's individual 2.0 mi length or 10-in diameter, so those two cells remain UNRESOLVED at the segment level (see fills).
validity.researcher_notes: Checked the MPSC's July 27, 2021 Order in Case No. U-20894 (mi-psc.my.site.com), the MPSC's own 2021-07-27 press release, the Manistee News Advocate article reporting it, a later Proposal for Decision from a 2024 DMLC rate case (Case No. U-21525) with sworn cross-examined testimony, the EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects workbook (project key 'rogers city and norwalk manistee connectors|dte michigan lateral', docket U-20894), and SEC EDGAR full-text search (0 hits for 'Rogers City Connector' -- too small to appear in DTE/DT Midstream's 10-K disclosures). All agree: DTE Michigan Lateral Company (DMLC), a certificated intrastate pipeline company, was authorized in July 2021 to convert its existing wet-gas-gathering Wet Header System to regulated dry gas transmission service and to construct two NEW connector pipelines -- this $7M Rogers City Connector (P4450) and the $13.9M Norwalk Manistee Connector (P4451) -- serving Manistee, Traverse City, Alpena and Rogers City. This is real, existing infrastructure, not a GEM-only entity. Same conclusion independently reached on sibling P4451's shard, which this shard corroborates rather than assumes.

The EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects workbook independently corroborates: every release from 2024-10 onward lists the combined project (docket U-20894, covering both connectors) 'Completed', completed_date 2023-02-15, year_in_service_date 2023. This same evidence and the same conclusion was independently reached for sibling P4451 -- confirmed here for P4450 against the primary documents myself, not assumed from the sibling shard.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The sheet's LastUpdated (2022-10) predates the pipeline's actual completion. Sworn testimony from DMLC's VP of Storage Assets in MPSC Case No. U-21525 (a 2023 rate case, PFD signed 2024-10-02) states 'the pipeline project became available for service on February 15, 2023,' and construction, though planned for 2021, 'began in 2022.' The EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects workbook independently corroborates from its 2024-10 release onward: status 'Completed', completed_date 2023-02-15, year_in_service_date 2023, for the same docket (U-20894), covering both connectors. Two genuinely independent sources (a Michigan Public Service Commission evidentiary proceeding and a federal EIA statistical survey) agree on the same date -- high confidence. Recommend Status -> operating, StartYear1 -> 2023 / StartMonth1 -> 2, ConstructionYear -> 2022. The sheet's ShelvedYear/CancelledYear/ShelvedCancelledType are already blank (verified against the 2026-09-14 snapshot), so no clearing is required alongside this change. This is the same correction independently reached on sibling P4451's shard, confirmed here against the primary documents for this row rather than assumed from it.

summary: P4450 (DTE Michigan Lateral / Rogers City Connector) is real, correctly attributed to DTE Michigan Lateral Co (100%), and not a duplicate of P4449/P4451 -- all three share one MPSC certificate (Case No. U-20894). MPSC Case U-20894 + a 2024 rate-case PFD (Case U-21525) + EIA independently show it went into service 2023-02-15 (construction began 2022) -- Status changes from proposed to operating (StartYear1 2023, ConstructionYear 2022). Length (2.0 mi) and Diameter (10 in) remain UNRESOLVED -- only a combined 6-mi total for both connectors is publicly documented; Capacity, Pressure and FuelSource also UNRESOLVED (not disclosed anywhere).
